title: Explainable AI for Fair and Transparent Credit Scoring
summary: A trustworthy credit scoring framework combining gradient boosted trees, fairness mitigation (Fairlearn), and explainability tools (SHAP, DiCE) for regulatory-compliant credit decisions. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic training data for the credit scoring pipeline.
